title: call_list — one row per OWNER (APNs semicolon-listed)
description: 40 delivery columns plus the required DNC companions. x-column-order is the single source of truth for column order; build_call_list.py reads it rather than re-declaring the list. Recorded for audit ONLY. A vendor's matchConfidence, matched:true, or a field literally named property_owner:true is NEVER an input to any predicate or gate (doctrines 2 and 4).
